title: Constrained Lab Runner Shift
brief: Fulfill three independent secured-carrier deliveries using only named safe waypoints, docks, and latch interfaces.

migration.legacyLearningObjective: Program Unitree G1 to complete the observable secured-carrier handling sequence; use checkpoint feedback for invalid proximity, sequence, or compatibility states; distinguish simulated apparatus state from learner-recorded evidence; return the runner home.
migration.redesignRationale: The legacy objective is preserved as observable lab logistics: G1 transports only mechanically secured carriers while people or compatible bench equipment perform manipulation and measurement.

provenance.label: M
provenance.claim: The displayed G1 visual chain uses the frozen official-URDF-derived model revision.

provenance.label: F
provenance.claim: The frozen v2 runtime restricts G1 to constrained waypoints, configured headings, docking, and the secured-carrier attachment interface.

provenance.label: R
provenance.claim: G1 serves only as a lab runner for multi-stop lab logistics; it does not perform free grasping, bench manipulation, measurement, or physical lifting. The required lift-role frame is planar dock clearance.

provenance.label: C
provenance.claim: Task frames, waypoint headings, 60 mm waypoint tolerances, safe transfer hub, dock placement, latch placement, and simulation release authorization are authored educational configuration.

source.notes: Official visual chain used only for constrained waypoint logistics visualization.
